description: Seguimiento de Obras de Agua y Cloaca (2024-2025) is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad de Cuenca Matanza Riachuelo (ACUMAR). Datos correspondientes al seguimiento efectuado por ACUMAR de las obras de provisión de agua potable y saneamiento cloacal realizadas en la Cuenca Matanza Riachuelo, a partir de 2024. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Autoridad de Cuenca Matanza Riachuelo (ACUMAR). Its tags are Calidad de Vida, Red de Agua Potable, Saneamiento Cloacal. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
